doc.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002

title: Broadway union salary cuts
summary: He gives his view of the musicians' union accepting cuts for Phantom and Les Miserables.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: And it didn’t last very long, because business came back. And I think actually I don’t know the whole truth behind the thing but I think maybe what money they withheld, the president of our union said we’ll cut the salary by twenty-five percent. But anyway I don’t want to go there because I wasn’t there so I don’t really under— No I don’t really,
to be totally honest about the thing I’m really occasionally I’ll get, like I’m on Ricky Martin “She Bangs.”
